note: PROBE + MEASURE SHAPE, byte-faithful body. The self-scoped read GET /api/v3/core/tokens/?intent=api the sync account makes of its own tokens. TokenViewSet.owner_field = 'user' scopes it to the bearer with zero grants, and `key` is absent from the serializer -- so this reads the expiry while being structurally unable to read the secret. Two api-intent tokens, both Expiring: the soonest binds the headroom, so a surplus token can never hide a nearer deadline. Identifiers and pks are synthetic.
